payload.summary: The full draft allocations scheme as residents saw it during the consultation, about 84,000 characters of it. Its value is as a before-and-after: read against the scheme the council adopted three months later, it shows which wording the consultation actually moved. The phrases “needs-led” and “professional judgement” appear nowhere in this draft and twice in the adopted scheme, and this draft gives extra preference to “a person fleeing violence” with rent arrears where the adopted scheme says “fleeing violence or domestic abuse”.
